caption: The drawing depicts a single gray metallic teapot positioned centrally within a faintly outlined square on a beige background. The teapot has a bulbous body, a tall narrow neck, a curved and flared spout extending from the left side, and a round, slightly domed lid with a brown knob on top. The handle, attached to the right side, is curved and brown, appearing to be made of wood or another material different from the main metallic body of the pot. The shadowing and highlights on the teapot suggest a smooth, polished surface. In the bottom left corner of the drawing's frame, there is a noticeable rectangular discoloration or stain, likely from tape or adhesive, in a light tan shade. The artist's name is inscribed in small print near the lower right corner within the outlined square.
title: Pewter Teapot
